body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> LDHK (www.miplug.com) introduced its multifunctional accessory 'MiPlug' at CES 2010, which is designed to enable to charge a mobile, synchronize data, reada memory card(micro-SD) and give it access to the internet on a computer thorough a mobile. MiPlug can also be used as a USB drive.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
